group:paper-mock-fujian-fuzhou-2025-m1:c.overview: 作者曾以做饭为乐，几次割伤后远离厨房；生活成本上涨后，她下决心重回厨房，第一次做成红酒炖牛肉带来成就感，重新爱上做饭，并体会到做饭可以是一种自我表达。
group:paper-mock-fujian-fuzhou-2025-m1:c.fullTranslationZh:
做饭一直是我的一点小乐趣。大约十年前，我从头学着做出美味的饭菜，从中找到了极大的快乐。然而，一连串的意外，包括几次不幸的割伤，让我对下厨变得犹豫。于是我逐渐远离了做饭，更多地依靠丈夫下厨或者叫外卖。不过最近，我决定重拾对做饭的热爱，这给我带来了很大的改变。
重新开始做饭并不容易。过去手受伤的记忆还在，害怕再次弄伤自己的恐惧也冒了出来。然而，随着生活成本不断上涨，我意识到只靠餐馆吃饭难以为继。于是，我带着决心重新走进了厨房。
真正重燃我做饭热情的一道菜谱，是朱莉娅·蔡尔德的红酒炖牛肉。电影《朱莉与朱莉娅》上映时，我爱上了做饭，却从未尝试过这道经典法国菜。它无疑是一项出于热爱的辛苦活，需要大量的时间、耐心和对细节的关注。从用盐和胡椒给牛肉调味，到把牛肉和红酒拌在一起，每一个步骤都是对风味与技艺的欢乐庆祝。第一次做这道菜给了我一种成就感，让我想起自己当初为什么爱上做饭。
做饭不必是一种负担——它可以是一种自我表达。

completedSourceTexts.text: Cooking has always been a small enjoyment of mine. About a decade ago, I found great joy in creating delicious meals from the beginning. However, a series of accidents, including a few unfortunate cuts, left me hesitant to cook. So I gradually distanced myself from cooking, relying more on my husband to cook or takeout. Recently, however, I decided to rediscover my love for cooking, and it’s been transformative.

Getting back into cooking wasn’t easy. Memories of past accidents with my hands remained, and the fear of injuring myself again appeared. However, as the cost of living continued to rise, I realized that relying only on restaurants wasn’t sustainable. So, with determination, I stepped back into the kitchen.

One recipe that has truly refueled my passion for cooking is Julia Child’s Beef Bourguignon（红酒炖牛肉）. When the movie Julie and Julia came out, I fell in love with cooking but never attempted this classic French dish. It’s certainly a labor of love, requiring a lot of time, patience, and attention to detail. From seasoning the beef with salt and pepper to mixing it with wine, every step is a joyous celebration of flavor and technique. Making it for the first time gave me a sense of accomplishment, reminding me why I fell in love with cooking.
Cooking doesn’t have to be a burden— it can be a form of self-expression.
